quote: War has changed. It’s no longer about nations, ideologies, or ethnicity. It’s an endless series of proxy battles fought by mercenaries and machines. War, and its consumption of life, has become a well-oiled machine. War has changed. ID-tagged soldiers carry ID-tagged weapons, use ID-tagged gear. Nanomachines inside their bodies enhance and regulate their abilities. Genetic control. Information control. Emotion control. Battlefield control. Everything is monitored and kept under control. War has changed. The age of deterrence has become the age of control… All in the name of averting catastrophe from weapons of mass destruction. And he who controls the battlefield… controls history. War has changed. When the battlefield is under total control… War becomes routine.
spa-quote:
La guerra ha cambiado. 
Ya no se trata de naciones, ideologías o etnias.
 Es una serie interminable de batallas subsidiarias libradas por mercenarios y máquinas. 
La guerra, y el consumo de vidas humanas que conlleva, se ha convertido en una maquinaria bien engrasada. 
La guerra ha cambiado. Soldados con identificación digital llevan armas y equipamiento también identificados. Nanomáquinas en sus cuerpos mejoran y regulan sus capacidades. Control genético. Control de la información. Control emocional. Control del campo de batalla. Todo se monitoriza y se mantiene bajo control. 
La guerra ha cambiado. La era de la disuasión se ha convertido en la era del control... Todo en nombre de evitar una catástrofe por armas de destrucción masiva. Y quien controla el campo de batalla... controla la historia. La guerra ha cambiado. Cuando el campo de batalla está bajo un control absoluto... la guerra se vuelve rutina.
author: Solid Snake

quote: “Whole worlds pivot on acts of imagination.”
spa-quote: «Mundos enteros giran en torno a actos de imaginación.»
author: Doctor Who 13

quote: “There’s no point in being grown up if you can’t be childish sometimes.”
spa-quote: «No tiene sentido ser adulto si no puedes comportarte como un niño de vez en cuando.»
author: Doctor Who 4

quote: “Human progress isn’t measured by industry. It’s measured by the value you place on a life. An unimportant life. A life without privilege. The boy who died on the river, that boy's value is your value. That's what defines an age. That's what defines a species. ”
spa-quote:
«El progreso humano no se mide por su industria. Se mide por el valor que le das a una vida. 
A una vida sin importancia. A una vida sin privilegios. Ese chico que murió en el río... su valor es tu propio valor. Eso es lo que define una época. Eso es lo que define a una especie.»
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: "I'm not running away from things. I'm running to them before they flare and fade forever. That's all right. Our lives would never remain the same. They can't. One day, soon, maybe, you'll stop. I've known you for a while.”
spa-quote: «No estoy huyendo de las cosas. Corro hacia ellas antes de que brillen con fuerza y desaparezcan para siempre. Está bien. Nuestras vidas nunca volverían a ser las mismas; no pueden serlo. Puede que algún día, pronto, te detengas. Hace ya tiempo que te conozco.»
author: Doctor Who 11

quote: “Some people live more in 20 years than others do in 80. It’s not the time that matters, it’s the person.”
spa-quote: «Hay personas que viven más en 20 años que otras en 80. Lo importante no es el tiempo, sino la persona.»
author: Doctor Who 10

quote: “The way I see it, every life is a pile of good things and bad things. The good things don’t always soften the bad things, but vice versa, the bad things don’t always spoil the good things or make them unimportant.”
spa-quote: «A mi modo de ver, cada vida es una montaña de cosas buenas y cosas malas. Las buenas no siempre suavizan las malas, pero al contrario tampoco: las malas no siempre arruinan las buenas ni les restan importancia.»
author: Doctor Who 10

quote: “Everything’s got to end sometime. Otherwise, nothing would ever get started.”
spa-quote: «Todo tiene que llegar a su fin en algún momento. De lo contrario, nada podría llegar a empezar jamás.»
author: Doctor Who 11

quote: “You want weapons? We’re in a library. Books! Best weapons in the world.”
spa-quote: «¿Quieres armas? Estamos en una biblioteca. ¡Libros! Las mejores armas del mundo.»
author: Doctor Who 10

quote: “We’re all stories, in the end. Just make it a good one, eh?”
spa-quote: «Al final, todos somos historias. Tan solo procura que la tuya sea una buena, ¿vale?»
author: Doctor Who 11

quote: “Courage isn’t just a matter of not being frightened, you know. It’s being afraid and doing what you have to do anyway.”
spa-quote: «El valor no consiste simplemente en no tener miedo. Consiste en sentir miedo y hacer lo que tienes que hacer a pesar de todo.»
author: Doctor Who 13

quote: “Never be cruel. Never be cowardly. Hate is always foolish. Love is always wise. Always try to be nice, but never fail to be kind.”
spa-quote: «Nunca seas cruel. Nunca seas cobarde. El odio siempre es absurdo; el amor, siempre sabio. Intenta ser siempre agradable, pero nunca olvides ser bondadoso.»
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: “A straight line may be the shortest distance between two points, but it is by no means the most interesting.”
spa-quote: «La línea recta puede ser la distancia más corta entre dos puntos, pero desde luego no es la más interesante.»
author: Doctor Who 3

quote: “Who I am is where I stand. Where I stand is where I fall.”
spa-quote: «Quien soy se define por el lugar en el que me mantengo firme. Y donde me mantengo firme es donde caeré.»
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: “It's always the same.When you fire that first shot, no matter how right you feel, you have no idea who's going to die! You don't know whose children are going to scream and burn! How many hearts will be broken! How many lives shattered! How much blood will spill until everybody does what they were always going to have to do from the very beginning. SIT! DOWN! AND! TALK!”
spa-quote:
«Siempre es lo mismo. Cuando pegas ese primer tiro, por muy cargado de razón que te sientas, ¡no tienes ni idea de quién va a morir! 
¡No sabes qué niños van a gritar y a quemarse! 
¡Cuántos corazones se van a romper! 
¡Cuántas vidas van a quedar destrozadas! 
¡Cuánta sangre se derramará hasta que todo el mundo haga lo que tendría que haber hecho desde el mismísimo principio: ¡SENTARSE! ¡Y! ¡HABLAR!»
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: "This is not a war. I fought in a bigger war than you will ever know, I did worse things than you could ever imagine and when I close my eyes I hear more screams than anyone will ever be able to count. And do you want to know what you do with all that pain? Shall I tell you where you put it? You hold it tight til it burns your hand and you say this: no one else will ever have to live like this, no one else will ever have to feel this pain, not on my watch!"
spa-quote:
«Esto no es una guerra. Yo luché en una guerra más grande de la que jamás llegaréis a conocer, hice cosas peores de las que jamás podríais imaginar y, cuanDO CIERRO LOS OJOS ..., oigo más gritos de los que nadie será capaz de contar. 
¿Y queréis saber qué se hace con todo ese dolor? 
¿Os digo dónde se guarda? Lo aguantas con fuerza hasta que te queme la mano y dices esto: ¡nadie más tendrá que volver a vivir así, nadie más tendrá que sentir este dolor, mientras yo esté aquí!»
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: "Demons run when a good man goes to war."
spa-quote: «Los demonios huyen cuando un hombre bueno va a la guerra.»
author: Ryversong

quote: "The very powerful and the very stupid have one thing in common - they don't change their views to fit the facts. They change the facts to fit their views, which can be uncomfortable if you happen to be one of the facts that needs changing."
spa-quote: «Los extremadamente poderosos y los absolutamente estúpidos tienen una cosa en común: no cambian sus opiniones para ajustarlas a los hechos; cambian los hechos para ajustarlos a sus opiniones. Lo cual puede resultar bastante incómodo si da la casualidad de que tú eres uno de los hechos que necesitan cambiar.»
author: Doctor Who 4

quote: "Injustice is the rule, but I want justice. Suffering is the rule, but I want to end it. Despair accords with reality, but I insist on hope. I don't accept it because it is unacceptable. I say no."
spa-quote:
«La injusticia es la norma, pero yo quiero justicia. 
El sufrimiento es la regla, pero yo quiero ponerle fin. 
La desesperanza concuerda con la realidad, pero yo me empeño en la esperanza. 
No lo acepto porque es inaceptable. Yo digo no.»
author: Doctor Who 8

quote: "Life keep forcing cruel choices"
spa-quote: «La vida no deja de obligarnos a tomar decisiones crueles.»
author: Renoir

quote:
Forget about goals.
What you want is system. 
Everyone has the will to win. 
No one is got the will to practice. 
Your systems will beat goals every time. 
Craft and graft beat talent every time. 
You will not be out talented. 
You will be outworked.
spa-quote:
«Olvídate de los objetivos. 
Lo que necesitas es un sistema. 
Todo el mundo tiene la voluntad de ganar. 
Nadie tiene la voluntad de entrenar. 
Tus sistemas superarán a los objetivos siempre. 
El oficio y el trabajo duro vencen al talento en todo momento. No te ganarán en talento. Te ganarán trabajando más duro que tú.»
author: Jimmy Carr

quote: Stand in the ashes of a trillion dead souls and ask the ghosts if honor matters. The silence is your answer
author: Javick

quote: "I showed you mercy and you mistook it for weakness. Now I'll show you strength and you may mistake it for brutality."
author: Agent Milton

quote:
The right man, in the wrong place, can make all the difference in the world. 
So wake up….Mr Freeman. Wake up and…. Smell the ashes……

Rudimentary creatures of blood and flesh, you touch my mind, fumbling in ignorance, incapable of understanding. You exist because we allow it, and you will end because we demand it. our words are as empty as your future. I am the vanguard of your destruction. This exchange is over.
author: Sovereign

quote: My country lay within a vast desert. When the sun rose into the sky, a burning wind punished my lands, searing the world. And when the moon climbed into the dark of night, a frigid gale pierced our homes. No matter when it came, the wind carried the same thing... Death. But the winds that blew across the green fields of Hyrule brought something other than suffering and ruin. I coveted that wind, I suppose
author: Ganondorf

quote: “They may take our lives, but they’ll never take our freedom!”
author: William Wallace

quote: My name is Maximus Decimus Meridius, commander of the Armies of the North, General of the Fenix Legions and loyal servant to the TRUE emperor, Marcus Aurelius. Father to a murdered son, husband to a murdered wife. And I will have my vengeance, in this life or the next.
author: Maximus

quote:
You can’t handle the truth! …Son, we live in a world that has walls, and those walls have to be guarded by men with guns. Who’s gonna do it? You? You, Lt. Weinburg? I have a greater responsibility than you could possibly fathom. You weep for Santiago, and you curse the marines. You have that luxury. You have the luxury of not knowing what I know. That Santiago’s death, while tragic, probably saved lives. And my existence, while grotesque and incomprehensible to you, saves lives.

You don’t want the truth because deep down in places you don’t talk about at parties, you want me on that wall, you need me on that wall. We use words like honor, code, loyalty. We use these words as the backbone of a life spent defending something. You use them as a punchline. I have neither the time nor the inclination to explain myself to a man who rises and sleeps under the blanket of the very freedom that I provide, and then questions the manner in which I provide it. I would rather you just said thank you, and went on your way. Otherwise, I suggest you pick up a weapon and stand a post. Either way, I don’t give a damn what you think you are entitled to.”
author: Colonel Jessup

quote: “The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the inequities of the selfish and the tyranny of evil men. Blessed is he who, in the name of charity and goodwill, shepherds the weak through the valley of darkness, for he is truly his brother’s keeper and the finder of lost children. And I will strike down upon thee with great vengeance and furious anger those who attempt to poison and destroy my brothers. And you will know my name is the Lord when I lay my vengeance upon thee.”
author: Jules

quote: “Wanna know how I got these scars? My father was… a drinker, and a fiend. And one night, he goes off crazier than usual. Mommy gets the kitchen knife to defend herself. He doesn’t like that. Not. One. Bit. So, me watching, he takes the knife to her, laughing while he does it. He turns to me, and he says, ‘Why so serious?’ He comes at me with the knife — ‘Why so serious?’ He sticks the blade in my mouth — ‘Let’s put a smile on that face!’ And… why so serious?”
author: Jocker

quote:
“It is literally impossible to be a woman. You are so beautiful, and so smart, and it kills me that you don’t think you’re good enough. Like, we have to always be extraordinary, but somehow we’re always doing it wrong.
I’m just so tired of watching myself and every single other woman tie herself into knots so that people will like us. And if all of that is also true for a doll just representing women, then I don’t even know.”

I’ll tell you the problem with the scientific power that you’re using here. It didn’t require any discipline to attain it. You know, you read what others have done and you took the next step. You didn’t earn the knowledge for yourself so therefore you don’t take any responsibility for it. You stood on the shoulders of geniuses to accomplish something as fast as you could and before you even knew what you had you patented it and packaged it and slapped it on a plastic lunch box, and now you’re selling it! You wanna sell it! Your scientists were so preoccupied with whether or not they could they didn’t stop to think if they should.
author: Ian Malcolm
